verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Exa has reference docs (search, contents, websets guides), markdown/llms.txt versions, and an integration-snippet generator. None of it shows an interactive API reference where examples can be run in-browser, such as a try-it console or playground. The snippet generator and the dashboard's 'Get Code' cURL output are adjacent features, not an interactive runnable reference. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path.
